plain: One small task in an exercise. It turns green when your code does it.
A line that starts with `#`. Python skips it. It is a note for people.
Join strings end to end with `+`.
Something the person running the program types in. `input()` waits for it and hands it back as a string.
What your program shows on the screen when it runs.
Text inside quotes. Python treats it as words, not as code.
A name that holds a value, so you can use the value later.
